name: @pipelab/cli
description: The command line interface for Pipelab
author: CynToolkit

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development tsx watch src/index.ts serve
scripts.dev:remote: cross-env NODE_ENV=development tsx watch src/index.ts serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 33753
scripts.test:release-platforms: vitest run -c tests/e2e/vitest.config.mts tests/e2e/tests/releases.spec.ts tests/e2e/tests/mac-signing-policy.spec.ts tests/e2e/tests/cloud-auth.spec.ts tests/e2e/tests/pipelab-cloud-release.spec.ts tests/e2e/tests/workflows.spec.ts tests/e2e/tests/release-provider-integration.spec.ts tests/e2e/tests/provider-flow-audit.spec.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.parity.json --composite false
